nodes.description: List of node IDs or objects

mechanism: A branching {{topology}} where multiple lines are explored simultaneously — lines of reasoning, of search, or of provenance. Allows backtracking and pruning of unpromising branches (BFS/DFS). A Tree is the constrained form of a directed acyclic graph where each non-root node has exactly one parent.
invariants: Rootedness: All nodes descend from a single root.
Acyclicity: No node is an ancestor of itself.

parameters.name: breadth
parameters.description: Maximum branches explored per node. Left open at the foundation: binary trees use 2, beam search uses 50+, decision trees can be millions. Descendants specialize.
